overview: The Medford Human Rights Commission planned a draft acknowledgement letter for International Human Rights Day and approved DEI touchstones for its meetings. The commission also reviewed upcoming community calendar events and heard an update from the police chief regarding the Islamic Cultural Center.

items.title: Introductions and Attendance
items.summary: Commissioners and staff introduced themselves and noted absences.

items.title: International Human Rights Day Acknowledgement Letter
items.summary: Commissioners discussed deadlines, readability standards, and drafting responsibilities for an acknowledgement statement to submit to the Senior Center newsletter and City Council ahead of International Human Rights Day.

items.title: Approval of September Minutes
items.summary: The commission moved and seconded approval of the September meeting minutes after minor typographical and date corrections.

items.title: DEI Touchstones
items.summary: The commission approved updated DEI touchstones to serve as meeting ground rules and codes of conduct after adding language on promoting human dignity.

items.title: Calendar and Outreach Updates
items.summary: Commissioners reviewed upcoming community events, discussed outreach and recruitment strategies, and noted the October 19 Charter Study Committee public hearing.

items.title: Inquiry Regarding Islamic Cultural Center
items.summary: Chief Buckley clarified that there have been no reported incidents at the Islamic Cultural Center in Medford Square following a resident question about boarded windows.
